proposed_branch: Test and, if retained, submit the translation-symmetric 50:50 Ru/Sb averaged B-site realization in its 10-site primitive cell.
reason: The submitted P-1 CIF is valid and primitive (Z=1), expands to an ordered, fully occupied 20-atom Ba4La2SbRuO12 cell, indexes the important peak families, and passes periodic-distance and bond-valence checks (Ba2+, La3+, Sb5+, Ru5+, O2-). However, the decisive Ru/Sb ordering is not established. The non-cation parent substructure is exactly related by the (1/2,1/2,1/2) translation, so placing 0.5 Ru + 0.5 Sb on each of the two B sites gives the same composition and a valid 10-site primitive averaged realization. Under the same independently fitted whole-profile model, that averaged realization is indistinguishable and slightly better than the submitted ordered CIF (Rwp 0.055402 versus 0.055416); their calculated-profile RMS difference is only 0.0057 intensity units versus about 0.12 noise. The strongest order-only reflections are just 0.33% and 0.16% of the calculated maximum and are not observed above noise. The trace compared only the two origin-equivalent choices of which B site is labeled Sb and never performed an ordered-versus-averaged occupancy test. Thus a material exact-structure occupancy/order choice is supported only by assumption, and another attempt could add the concrete I-centered 50:50 Ru/Sb averaged branch.
